brand_identity.name: GeckoLabs
brand_identity.symbol_spec: Low-poly geometric gecko vector emblem crafted with faceted polygonal triangles (#1F2937, #374151, #064E3B, #10B981, #22C55E). Features precision vertices and subtle circuit micro-tracks, emphasizing architectural rigidity and biomimetic stealth.
brand_pillars: Production-proven add-ons for Kubernetes, Kafka, Figma & WebAssembly
Audited deterministic performance and instant SDK downloads

visual_enhancers.geometric_grid_background: Subtle 24px blueprint grid (radial gradient mask) overlaid with random vertex nodal dots and thin neon-emerald tracer lines.
visual_enhancers.kinetic_reveal: Line-by-line staggered text unfold with spring physics using framer-motion (0.04s stagger, duration 0.6s).
visual_enhancers.editorial_ticker: Slow-drifting horizontal ribbon using marquee motion featuring runtime benchmarks, kernel tags, and zero-downtime stamps.
visual_enhancers.manifesto_chapters: Numbered architectural chapters (e.g., 01 // COMPILED CORE, 02 // ZERO ALLOCATION, 03 // AIR-GAPPED VERIFICATION) rendered with mono micro-labels and raw technical diagrams.
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Active product and pricing cards bordered by a traveling 1px gradient beam (#10B981 -> #22C55E -> transparent).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js and .jsx files) exclusively, matching the existing CRA configuration. Do NOT generate .tsx or TypeScript files.
Implement default dark mode (#090B0D) with an ultra-smooth switch to light mode via a ThemeContext or next-themes/Tailwind dark class.
Embed the official GeckoLabs brand mark: A faceted low-poly gecko SVG in dark-green/charcoal tones paired with 'GECKO LABS — SOFTWARE ENGINEERING & ARCHITECTURE'.
Ensure the hero section feels award-worthy: line-by-line kinetic reveal on load, mono architectural chapters (01 // COMPILED CORE), and subtle geometric grid background.
Include a slow editorial ribbon/marquee with technical stack benchmarks (eBPF, Rust, WASM, Envoy, Citus).

Ensure all pages are fully functional: Home, Products Catalog with interactive filters, Product Detail with license selector, persistent Cart & Checkout with realistic Stripe modal, Account Portal (Licenses, Orders, Downloads), Auth (Login/Register with 1-click demo accounts), and Support/Terms.
Provide immediate working demo data: users can purchase products, generate instant cryptographic keys, and download simulated .tar.gz / .zip packages in the Account portal.
Use Sonner for toasts upon adding to cart, applying promo codes, and copying license tokens.
Every key interactive element must have a role-based data-testid attribute for robust testing.
